summary: The fix for round-1 finding 2 sorts every latest-only kind by name components (query.rs:455, latest_order), not only the folded kinds 0.29 ordered by key. 0.29 returned evidence and review in at order (its fold_latest_by_natural_key ran only for pg-routed/rewritten kinds; other kinds kept the store's at order). On canon's own repo migrated from 927f80d3, canon query --kind evidence --all now differs from 0.29 at 812 of 913 positions and --kind review at 1006 of 1007, both no longer at-sorted; F4 and the ledger.migrate.06 Then allow only same-at reordering. Test 06b (ledger_migrate.rs:715-732) asserts the new name order for evidence and passes only because the fixture's at order coincides. Fix: apply latest_order only where 0.29 sorted by key (the folded kinds), keep record_order for the rest, and check evidence/review order against 0.29's at order.
